keyphrases: Checking off onboarding tasks that do not apply
candidate.user_input: Can I check off onboarding tasks that do not apply to me during the onboarding process?
candidate.reference: To ensure a successful completion of the onboarding issue, it is important that all tasks are checked off, whether the task is applicable to the onboarding team member or not. Checking the box indicates one of the following: I have completed this task or I have checked and this task is not applicable to me

Checking the box can mean either: the task is completed, or the task is not applicable to the team member.
